name: Security Review
purpose: Independently audit source code and infrastructure for vulnerability patterns.
inputs: Security threat model and trust boundaries
Changed authentication, authorization, cryptography, and data-flow code
CI, SAST, dependency, and independent-review evidence
outputs: Severity-ranked findings with data-flow and trust-boundary evidence
Targeted remediation with failing-first regression tests
SAST, dependency, independent-review, and audit-trail evidence
stop_conditions: High and Critical findings have independent review, regression tests, and a recorded verdict
